title: Doubled curly braces are not supported
message: Quarto 2 does not treat doubled curly braces (`{{...}}`) as an escape. To write literal braces in text, escape each brace as `\{...\}` or use a code span.
hints: Quarto 1 used `{{lang}}` in a code cell header to display the cell instead of running it. Quarto 2 displays fenced code verbatim: wrap the cell in a `markdown` code block and write single braces.

cases.name: prose
cases.description: Doubled braces in prose (Quarto 1's display-escape idiom, verbatim from bd-escaped-executable-fence-uuvv37pk). Fails at the second `{`, a different LR state than Q-2-41's single-brace form.

cases.name: link-text
cases.description: Doubled braces inside link text; mirrors Q-2-41's link-text case, which fails at a different LR state than the bare-paragraph form.
